lines.text: 一个星期以后，大厨的手好了。他回到厨房的第一件事，就是把炒勺交到小周手里：“以后，你跟着我学。”
lines.py: yí gè xīng qī yǐ hòu, dà chú de shǒu hǎo le. tā huí dào chú fáng de dì yī jiàn shì, jiù shì bǎ chǎo sháo jiāo dào Xiǎo Zhōu shǒu lǐ: “yǐ hòu, nǐ gēn zhe wǒ xué.”
lines.en: A week later, the chef's hand has healed. The first thing he does back in the kitchen is put the wok ladle into Xiao Zhou's hand. "From now on, you train with me."

lines.text: 老板苦笑着说：“好不容易发现了一个好厨师，却丢了一个最好的服务员。”
lines.py: lǎo bǎn kǔ xiào zhe shuō: “hǎo bù róng yì fā xiàn le yí gè hǎo chú shī, què diū le yí gè zuì hǎo de fú wù yuán.”
lines.en: The owner gives a wry smile. "I finally find a good cook, and I lose my best waiter."
